title: Oaxaca’s 3rd Forum in Defense of Territory and Social Property: April 15 in Santa María Atzompa
author: Desinformémonos
content:

Organizations, communities, and land defenders have called for the 3rd Forum
in Defense of Territory and Social Property in Oaxaca, to be held on April 15
in Santa María Atzompa, with the aim of strengthening community organization
in the face of threats to communal and ejido lands.

The call comes after agreements reached in previous meetings and in a context
of concern about legislative reforms that, they pointed out, put the rights of
Indigenous and agrarian communities at risk by facilitating extractive
projects and weakening mechanisms for consultation, participation and
autonomy.

According to the organizations, the advance of the extractivist model through
mining concessions, energy megaprojects and water privatization has violated
social property and the right to self-determination of peoples, in addition to
affecting the legal security of territories.

The forum will seek to analyze the impact of these policies, strengthen
regional coordination, and build legal, organizational, and political
strategies for the defense of the territory, while also calling on
communities, agrarian authorities, and collectives to participate in this
space for collective action.

## CONVOCATORIA

3rd Foro in Defense of Territory and Social Property in Oaxaca

With the objective of following up on the agreements emanating from the 2nd
Forum in Defense of Territory and Social Property in Oaxaca, held in Santa
María Atzompa on April 10, 2025, in which 72 representatives of Agrarian
Communities and Authorities, Social Organizations, defenders and the general
public participated, we agreed to maintain and reinforce our processes of
unity and resistance, strengthening our internal regulations and communal
statutes, as well as the regional and state articulation in defense of our
rivers, forests, flora, fauna and everything that comprises our territory.

Today, in the face of the recent threats facing our Indigenous and Afro-
Mexican peoples and communities, it is urgent to analyze the effects of
current legislative reforms, which directly impact the rights of Indigenous
and agrarian communities. These reforms, in various areas, have created risks
to communal land ownership, facilitated the advancement of extractive
projects, and weakened mechanisms for consultation, participation, and
autonomy recognized in the constitutional framework and international
instruments.

We observe with concern how the extractive model continues to be imposed on
our territories through mining concessions, energy megaprojects, water
privatization, and changes in agrarian and administrative regulations that
affect the legal security of communal and ejido lands. All of this violates
the right to self-determination, autonomy, and the free, prior, and informed
consent of Indigenous peoples and communities.

For this reason, we are convening the 3rd Forum in Defense of Territory and
Social Property in Oaxaca, which will take place on April 15, 2026 at 08:00
hours, at the OIDHO facilities, located at Calle Capulines #4B , Col.
Forestal, in Santa María Atzompa, Oaxaca.

This space will have the following objectives: To strengthen community
organization and regional articulation for the defense of social property and
territory in Oaxaca, to analyze the implications of current reforms in
agrarian, territorial and indigenous matters, to evaluate the impact of the
extractivist model in our territories, strengthening our common agenda for the
defense of social property in Oaxaca to promote legal, organizational and
political strategies for the protection of our collective rights and communal
territory.

We call upon the Communities, Agrarian Authorities, Social Organizations,
Collectives, Defenders of the Territory and the people in general to actively
participate in this space for reflection and collective action.

No to megaprojects of death!  
No to the looting and plundering of our lands and territories!  
Yes to life and collective ownership of the territory!  
Respect for the autonomy and self-determination of our peoples!

Permanent Forum in Defense of Territory and Social Property in Oaxaca:
Indigenous Organizations for Human Rights in Oaxaca (OIDHO), Popular
Revolutionary Front – FPR, Mixe People's Services AC, Flor y Canto Indigenous
Rights Center AC, Services for Alternative Education AC EDUCA, Tequio Jurídico
AC, Center for Support of the Oaxacan Popular Movement, CAMPO AC, Council of
Communities in Resistance of Oaxaca CCORO, Assembly of Indigenous Peoples of
the Isthmus in Defense of Land and Territory – APIIDTT
